name: 23 ECT Single Wall (B-flute)
note: 23 ECT is a standard certified board grade (Box Maker's Certificate rating) for lighter-duty single-wall shipping cases. B-flute caliper is typically ~0.118in (118 mils); exact caliper varies by mill.

name: 32 ECT Single Wall (C-flute)
note: 32 ECT is the most common certified grade for general shipping cartons. C-flute caliper is typically ~0.160in (160 mils); exact caliper varies by mill.

name: 44 ECT Single Wall (C-flute)
note: 44 ECT is a heavier-duty certified single-wall grade, same typical C-flute caliper as 32 ECT.

name: 48 ECT Double Wall (B/C-flute)
note: Double-wall certified grade for heavier loads/export cases. Caliper is a typical combined B/C-flute figure; varies by mill.

name: 20 ECT Single Wall (A-flute)
note: 20 ECT is a real, lower-tier certified grade for light-duty cartons. A-flute is the thickest common single-wall flute, typically ~0.187in (187 mils) caliper.

name: 60 ECT Double Wall (A/C-flute)
note: 60 ECT is a common heavy-duty certified double-wall grade for export or heavy product cases. Caliper is a typical combined A/C-flute figure; varies by mill.
